security.evidence: Input is validated server-side everywhere it is trusted (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:29, app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:56, app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:16-20); sensitive actions are rate-limited inside the components (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:31-45, app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:46-66); verification requires a signed URL plus id/hash equality (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:16-26, routes/web.php:52-54); logout invalidates the session and regenerates CSRF (app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:13-16) and reset rotates remember_token (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:33-38); all output uses {{ }} and User keeps Fillable/Hidden attributes.

scope.evidence: The diff serves authentication plus pt-BR localization (routes, Livewire components, controllers, views, lang files, tests, README/CHANGELOG). Unrelated noise: the import-style rewrite in bootstrap/providers.php:3-8 and newline/quote-only churn in lang/pt_BR/{auth,pagination,passwords,validation}.php.

issues.explanation: Laravel's AuthServiceProvider already registers SendEmailVerificationNotification for the Registered event, so this extra Event::listen invokes the listener twice and registration sends two verification e-mails.
The limiter is only hit after a successful registration, so invalid attempts never count toward the required five attempts; the throttle should apply to every attempt, not just successful ones.
The text "Bulma CSS" is still hardcoded instead of coming from ui.*, contrary to the requirement that all screen text be translated.
The logout test only asserts the redirect and guest state; it never checks that the session was invalidated or the CSRF token regenerated, so half of requirement 3 is untested.
Notification::assertSentTo passes even when the verification notification is sent twice, so the duplicated-listener bug is invisible; assert the exact number of notifications sent.
The mount() auth check duplicates the guest middleware guarding /login and /register (same at app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:25), adding dead defence.
Passing the whole Request object to the reset view is unnecessary indirection; pass the token and e-mail values explicitly.
The page title uses ui.login instead of a forgot-password title key, which is misleading on the reset-request page.
The import-style rewrite of bootstrap/providers.php and the newline/quote churn in lang/pt_BR/{auth,pagination,passwords,validation}.php are unrelated to authentication and add diff noise.

review.summary: The change adds the full session-auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, signed e-mail verification), pt-BR-first translations and a shared Bulma layout, with broad Pest coverage. The main functional problem is a duplicated Registered-to-SendEmailVerificationNotification listener that sends the verification e-mail twice; smaller issues are that registration throttling only counts successful attempts, one hardcoded UI string, and test gaps around logout session handling and duplicate notifications. Overall it needs changes before merging.
